written: 2026-09-18, after the phase-0 gate showed Qwen3-VL-2B collapsing to answer 'A' (argmax share 1.00 on dtc and hg); before any probe query was run
question: Does Qwen3-VL-2B carry usable visual signal once option-position bias is removed?
frames: ~150 per scenario (defend_the_center, health_gathering) sampled from uniform-random play; oracle target class from the eval-only labels buffer (nearest target by on-screen bbox height; left < 0.4 < center < 0.6 < right of screen width; 'none' if no target)

variants.A_original: the gate prompt, fixed option order
variants.B_permuted: same prompt, 4 random option orders, probabilities mapped back to actions and averaged
variants.C_calibrated: B divided by the model's B-distribution on a blank black image (contextual calibration), renormalised
variants.D_perception: 'where is the nearest monster/medkit' with options left/center/right/none, 4 permutations averaged

metrics.action variants (A,B,C): on frames with a visible target: mean probability mass on the oracle-correct action set, and argmax-in-set rate; compared with a uniform policy
metrics.perception (D): 4-way accuracy vs oracle class, compared with the majority-class rate

decision_rule.use_debiased_action_teacher: best of B/C has argmax-in-set rate >= uniform-set rate + 0.15 on BOTH dtc and hg -> rerun the gate with that variant
decision_rule.use_perception_teacher: else if D accuracy >= majority rate + 0.20 on both -> perception-label teacher
decision_rule.negative: else report that the 2B VLM carries no usable visual signal for these tasks

addendum_resolution_check.written: 2026-09-18, after the 1x probe failed every variant; before any upscaled query
addendum_resolution_check.motivation: at 320x180 a frame is ~66 image tokens; distant targets are smaller than one merged 32px patch
addendum_resolution_check.change: same frames, same oracle, same variants and decision rule; frames upscaled 2x (640x360) and 3x (960x540) with bicubic interpolation before Qwen sees them
addendum_resolution_check.decision: if either scale passes the original rule on both scenarios, that scale is used for the teacher; otherwise the negative stands
